title: VMM 100 Miles — official distance page
claims: The 100 miles page lists 161 km with 8,800 m of gain and says the distance is brought back for 2026 after being created as Vietnam's first miler.
The page says '2028 Race dates: to be updated' while its pacer schedule refers to Thursday 17/09/2026 and Friday 18/09/2026.

The 100 miles cut-offs are 13:30 at CP Sa Pa, 20:00 at CP M4, 04:00 Saturday at CP M7, 10:00 at CP Topas Ecolodge, 17:00 at CP2, 20:00 at CP3, 23:00 at CP4, 01:30 Sunday at CP5, 04:30 at CP6, 06:15 at CP7 and 09:00 at the finish.
The 100 miles page badges the race as a 6-point ITRA race, an ITRA National League race, a 100M UTMB Index race and a Western States 2027 qualifying race.
Pacers are allowed for the final 70 km from CP Topas Ecolodge at km 86.3, must carry the 70km mandatory kit, must register by 18/8/2026 and may only be changed at checkpoints.
The 100 miles page allows three bags — finish, CP M5 and CP2 — handed in at the start line.

verification.note: 该页是 2026 届内容（pacer 日期为 2026 年 9 月 17–18 日），但日期行写 '2028 Race dates: to be updated'，与英文主页的 2027 TBD 不一致。
